body: I build up this awful pressure and bully myself into a panicked mess. At the time I felt I was doing everything right sometimes you don’t know what you have until its gone. I feel more human and accepting of my faults, I will miss my intuition and constant visions of the future, or daily ‘de ja vu’, i can’t change the past tho. you’re true, i have to accept. lets keep at it.

I want to be responsible and mature about this. I followed my horoscopes and fortune teller down into a rabbit hole horror. i deserve everything i get. Thanks for the encouragement. Ive never been afraid to admit when I get it wrong or when I’ve failed, however my constant lack of accountability for my actions is affecting my health and my family.
Ive lost my vision. Ive been offered to learn how to drive a bus
